# telnyx_ai_test_scenarios (Data Source)

Lists ai test scenarios, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_test_scenario`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_id` (Number)
- `assistant_id` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `tags` (String)

### Read-Only

- `ai_test_scenarios` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_test_scenarios))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_test_scenarios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_test_scenarios`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (Number) ID of the test agent the scenario runs against.
- `created_at` (String)
- `dynamic_variable_values` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `expected_outcome_prompt` (String) What a successful conversation looks like; scored by the expected-outcome metric.
- `first_message` (String) First message the simulated caller speaks or sends.
- `folder_path` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `inbound_phone_number` (Number)
- `inbound_phone_number_data` (String)
- `instructions` (String) What the simulated caller should do during the conversation.
- `last_updated_by` (Number)
- `metric_names` (List of String)
- `metrics` (List of Number) Metric IDs applied to the scenario.
- `name` (String)
- `personality` (Number) ID of the test personality the caller simulates.
- `personality_name` (String)
- `phone_number` (String) Outbound phone number used to place the simulated call.
- `scenario_language` (String)
- `scenario_type` (String) Type of scenario: workflow, red_teaming_voice, or red_teaming_text.
- `tags` (List of String)
- `test_profile` (Number)
- `test_profile_data` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_test_scenarios--test_profile_data))
- `tool_ids` (List of String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--ai_test_scenarios--test_profile_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_test_scenarios.test_profile_data`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `information` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `name` (String)
- `project` (Number)
